title: Detection of Conspiracy Theories Beyond Keyword Bias in German-Language Telegram Using Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting conspiracy theories using various language models. It evaluates performance metrics such as F1 scores and addresses dataset-specific keyword bias. While it mentions the harmful social impacts of conspiracy theories (e.g., antisemitism), it does not benchmark or study religious values, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within the models themselves.
